nodes.summary: Let `w ≥ 0` be edge weights, `L` the Laplacian and `d` the weighted degrees. Let `z` be centered with respect to `d` (the vertices where `z > 0`, and those where `z < 0`, each have volume at most `d(V)/2`) with `zᵀDz = ∑_a d(a) z(a)² > 0`. Then some threshold set `S_τ = {a : z(a) < τ}` has conductance `φ(S_τ) = w(∂S_τ) / min(d(S_τ), d(V \ S_τ)) ≤ √(2 zᵀLz / zᵀDz)`; the conductance is stated here multiplied out,…

nodes.summary: Let `d` be the weighted degrees and `λ` a lower bound for the generalized Rayleigh quotient `yᵀLy / yᵀDy` over all `y` with `∑_a d(a) y(a) = 0` (the second-smallest eigenvalue `ν₂` of the normalized Laplacian is the best such bound). nodes.title: Volume of a vertex set

nodes.summary: For nonnegative weights `w`, every weighted degree `d(a) = ∑_e w_e [a is an endpoint of e]` is nonnegative. For positive conductances on a loopless multigraph, `d(a)` is the weight `π(a)` of R. Lyons and Y. Peres, *Probability on Trees and Networks*, Cambridge University Press 2016, corrected online version of 19 August 2026, Section 2.1: the sum of the weights of the edges incident to `a`.
nodes.title: Weighted degrees are nonnegative

can_prove.label: ready to prove

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.
